messages:
anya: heads up — nightly model-refresh cron (03:00 UTC) failed CI.
ci-bot: [alert] cron/model-refresh failed: exit 1. See logs: https://ci.internal/runs/1773531163 :warning:
sam: is this the old kvcache timeout or a new pattern?
anya: new stacktrace. workers are blocking on kvcache_sync() then a long stall (~10m) before shard timeout.
leo: log excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T03:12:43Z [worker-7] ERROR kvcache: sync failed: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-15T03:12:44Z [bench] WARN request handler blocked waiting for kvcache locks
2026-03-15T03:22:50Z [ci] ERROR shard 7 timed out after 600s
```
maria: can we just rerun shard 7? if it's flaky that should clear it.
anya: please do — rerun shard 7, and if it flakes again start a bisect with --trace-locks.
sam: assigning rerun to @maria. @leo can you attach full logs to the issue when you have them?
maria: requesting GPU slot (1x T4) from eng-infra, will rerun once allocated.
eng-infra-bot: allocation queued (#A-4821). ETA ~10m.
ci-bot: command accepted: `./ci rerun --job cron/model-refresh --shard 7 --reason "kvcache timeout"`
maria: kicked off rerun (run 1773531578). will report back.
leo: small flag — PR #2043 changed kv lock ordering in runtime. could be related, leaving note here.
anya: noted. prefer bisect over full rollback; keep canary option ready.
ryan: I prepared a canary build that excludes #2043 and uploaded it to internal bucket if we need a quick test.
sam: bisect plan: run nightly binary across the last 6 merges with --trace-locks, narrow by repro. I can launch bisect once GPUs are available.
maria: rerun passed for shard 7 ✅ (run 1773531620). but full job now failed on shard 12 with similar kvcache timeout.
anya: okay triage update — escalate to bisect if rerun fails again on other shards.
maria: starting a full rerun and capturing pod events + dmesg to help root cause.
ci-bot: rerun triggered: 1773531690 (full). logs: https://ci.internal/runs/1773531690
ci-bot: update: full rerun (1773531725) failed on shard 12 with same kvcache timeout; marking for bisect.
sam: starting bisect job now, tagging @leo and @ryan to help collect repro artifacts and test the canary without #2043.
anya: thanks all — low customer impact but want to close this flaky before weekly metrics. :thumbsup:
maria: will post bisect progress here (starting 1773533525).
